name: Inside of Phone
source:
There is another world in this Universe, The world of emojis. Gwyneth accidentally travels from her phone to the emoji world, which is divided into seven distinct cities, where she will experience the lives of the emojis and help them accomplish their tasks. This world now seems peaceful, but a terrible attack is being secretly planned...

[From [url=https://cabbbagee.itch.io/inside-of-phone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个宇宙里还有另一个世界，表情符号的世界。格温妮丝无意中从手机中穿越到了表情符号世界，这个世界分为七个不同的城市，在那里她将体验表情符号的生活并帮助他们完成任务。这个世界现在看似平静，但一场可怕的袭击正在秘密策划……

[来自[url=https://cabbbagee.itch.io/inside-of-phone]Itch.io[/url]]
